lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are organized into approximately five observable vertical columns posterior to the fifth gill slit. The spatial density of these centroids decreases as they transition towards the posterior flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular high-luminance blobs, establishing a grid-like visual structure across the mid-lateral region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity highlights on the superior edge and deep shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a remora (Echeneidae) attached ventrally near the base of the left pectoral fin; the pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of small high-luminance blobs distinct from the larger flank constellations.
